title: Show which reader tasks actually ran
summary: Give the README audit a per-task coverage view that distinguishes a completed pass, a failure, and checks that were skipped or unsupported across rendered navigation and first-use actions.

origin.source: 2026-11-19 · README HQ audit findings #119 and #126 and the first-use proof discussion.

benefits: A reviewer can see whether a green aggregate included the reader journey they care about.
risks: A viewer could treat an unsupported format or unavailable runner as a passing check if those states are hidden in a summary.

evidence.claim: The plan records omitted rendered navigation and skipped first-action verification as distinct problems.
